name: md2epub
description: Convert a folder of Markdown into a reflowable EPUB 3.

scripts.build: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git -C ../.. log -1 --format=%ct) node bin/md2epub.js ../.. -a hiepgithub2001 --mermaid render/mermaid.js --base-url ${BASE_URL:-https://hiepgithub2001.github.io/swedocs/read} --source-url ${SOURCE_URL:-https://github.com/hiepgithub2001/swedocs/blob/main} --each -o ../../dist/books
scripts.build:one: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git -C ../.. log -1 --format=%ct) node bin/md2epub.js ../.. -a hiepgithub2001 --mermaid render/mermaid.js --base-url ${BASE_URL:-https://hiepgithub2001.github.io/swedocs/read} --source-url ${SOURCE_URL:-https://github.com/hiepgithub2001/swedocs/blob/main} -o ../../dist/swedocs.epub -t 'swedocs — Software Knowledge Base'
scripts.test: npm run build:strict --silent && npm run validate --silent
